featured_reviews.name: Sushant Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I have been sourcing all my bath fitting requirements from Monarch Bath Pvt Ltd since 2016 for various projects, including my farmhouse bungalows and my restaurant. After nearly a decade of partnership, I can confidently say their products are absolutely genuine and reasonably priced.
​What truly sets them apart is their integrity; it is clear that customer satisfaction takes priority over profit. Their staff is incredibly knowledgeable and provides exceptional guidance during the selection process. Even after 10 years, the products I first purchased are working smoothly without any costly maintenance. Their after-sales service is equally impressive. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and reliability!
